report.summary: Reviewed the generated connector's command-capture, exact-match completion, single-completion guard, and setup instructions, plus the local CLI/preflight and selector logic. Core flow is sound: observe() stores the command synchronously before the native click, completeProofOperation rejects missing/mismatched commands and stale or duplicate completions via entry.completed, and reports keep runtimeVerified/backendVerified false with no registration. Found one concrete preflight defect: child-combinator matching is unsound (element parent links are skipped), so a CLI "ready" verdict can be based on a match no browser would produce. Not executed; source-only review.

findings.title: Child combinator treated as descendant in static preflight
findings.evidence: parent(n) returns only when n.parentNode is an Element (line 65), so for n under a non-element parent (e.g. document/fragment) it returns undefined. In matchChain, `if(s.relations[index-1]==="child")return!!p&&matchChain(p,s,index-1);` then falls through to `while(p)` which is skipped, so the failure is silent. This yields both a false positive (match accepted when an intermediate non-element node sits between the two compounds, which parsed markup never has) and a false negative: when a part has both a descendant and a child relation (index>=2), a descendant ancestor match that is not the direct parent sets p to the grandparent and then requires the next match against the grandparent, dropping the parent link.
findings.reproduction: Unexecuted reasoning trace: selector `form button[type=submit]` cannot fail this way since there are two parts, but for a three-part selector like `section > form button` (parseable: spaces then `>` is allowed), matchChain(button, idx2) needs a parent match on `form`; if not direct, p becomes the grandparent and `section` must equal it, not the real `form`'s ancestors. In flat DOMs this mostly coincides, but a document-level part or extra wrapper makes matches wrong. Also test file line 30-31 only verifies two-part child selectors.
findings.suggestion: Make child relations strict: when relations[index-1] is 'child', return parent(n) maps to undefined => false (call matchChain only if p exists), and memoize/compare the immediate parent only, not the fallback ancestor loop.

limitations: Source-only static review; no tests, CLI runs, or browser checks were executed, and generated connector behavior was not run against the real seller-dom-adapter/bridge.
Runtime/browser contract compliance (real clicks, bridge messages, backend routes) is outside this slice and remains unverified by design (runtimeVerified/backendVerified stay false).
HTML parsing semantics rely on parse5; only the supplied packet was inspected, so the sample controls.html and reference workers were not available to confirm findings.
